items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Now Jimmy Harrison, I never saw him but I heard him.

ctx.x: You should hear Coleman Hawkins. Yeah.

So Joe Oliver, now there's the whole, there's Bix Bydebeck, Tea Garden. I saw Bix Bydebeck. See I have some, I saw something where a whole lot of people didn't see it. And I'm great. Bix Bydebeck was a great trumpet player. They had a whole lot of great white musicians too. There was this boy, this client, this player, what was his name, from around Chicago here? Tex. Yeah, Tex was great. Now that was Art Castle. I played against Art Castle with Dennis Goodman out the midway. And Moksi was the trumpet player.…

I was going to ask you, I don't want to put you on the spot, but I mean if you don't mind saying who would be your favorite trombone player. There's nothing wrong with having a favorite, I mean that's not insulting the other people, because I know you like a lot of them, you told me you liked a whole bunch of them. Well if you had to pick one or two.
